name: @finapp/m19-finance
description: M19 (3.1) — finance operations foundation: accounting entities, chart of accounts + ledger accounts, the fiscal calendar (fiscal years + accounting periods with open/closed/locked state), currencies + FX rates, cost centres, analytical dimensions, tax codes + rates, payment terms, and finance configuration. The finance reference-data foundation consumed by reconciliation (m15), GL reconciliation (m20) and the journal engine (m21). Owns NO journals, NO postings, NO reconciliation.
